SELECT , , ru.nickname AS reply_to_nickname, LEFT(p.content, 120) AS reply_to_content FROM blog_comment c JOIN blog_article a ON a.article_id = c.article_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN blog_comment p ON p.comment_id = c.parent_id AND p.article_id = c.article_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.user_id = p.user_id WHERE c.article_id = #{article} AND c.comment_id IN #{id}
ORDER BY c.create_time, c.comment_id ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.comment_id DESC

SELECT c.* FROM blog_comment c SELECT , , ru.nickname AS reply_to_nickname, LEFT(p.content, 120) AS reply_to_content FROM blog_comment c JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id JOIN blog_article a ON a.article_id = c.article_id LEFT JOIN blog_comment p ON p.comment_id = c.parent_id AND p.article_id = c.article_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.user_id = p.user_id
WHERE c.comment_id = #{id} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blog_article s WHERE s.article_id = c.article_id AND s.author_id = #{author})
